description: Create a principal identity (human or org behind agents) with its own Ed25519 keypair, held in this process as the session principal with a new fleet. Returns the full public key, and the full private key once on a local (stdio) server. On a remote server (MCP_TRANSPORT=sse or MCP_REMOTE=1) the private key is redacted, as in generate_keys. If a principal already exists in this process the call is refused unless replace=true, because replacing discards the current principal's private key and fleet from this process.

replace.description: Replace an existing principal. Discards the current principal's private key and fleet from this process, so save the key first.

name: create_principal
title: Create Principal Identity
